subject: Supplier billing intake: portal vs. email + template clarifications
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlight-logistics.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@starlight-logistics.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor setup & invoice submission options (Starlight)

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the onboarding call earlier — quick follow-up from our AP team. We have two questions before we start sending invoices:

1) Do you require invoices to be submitted only through your vendor portal, or can we continue sending to accounts-payable@redwood.com while we finish integration?
2) Is there a preferred invoice layout / CSV sample we should follow to avoid manual rework? We attach a sample invoice exported from our system (sample_invoice_starlight.xlsx).

We'd like to avoid missing PO matching fields; can you confirm what must be present on each invoice for automatic ingest?

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Vendor Operations Manager
Starlight Logistics

Attachment: sample_invoice_starlight.xlsx (Excel, 42 KB)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlight-logistics.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor setup & invoice submission options (Starlight)

Hi Marta — great to hear from you. Short answers up front: you can use the portal (preferred for new suppliers) or email as a temporary fallback during integration. A couple of notes to make sure invoices enter our AP pipeline cleanly: 

- Required fields for automatic PO matching: Redwood PO number, Invoice number, Invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD), Line-level description, Unit price, Quantity, Currency.
- Optional but highly recommended: Seller tax ID / VAT, Payment terms code (e.g., NET30), and a single-line narrative for any credit/adjustment.

Portal benefits: automated acknowledgements, early validation errors (missing PO, invalid tax ID), and higher retention for audit logs. Email benefits: quick start, but our AP team does manual upload for email submissions and some fields may require follow-up.

I've attached our onboarding form (starlight_onboarding_form_v1.pdf) with the onboarding checklist and AP field mapping. Marissa, can you confirm whether the AP mapping we shared last quarter changed?

Olga Petrov
Vendor Success — Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.com

Attachment: starlight_onboarding_form_v1.pdf (PDF, 78 KB)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlight-logistics.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Jenkins <tom.jenkins@starlight-logistics.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 00:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor setup & invoice submission options (Starlight)

Thanks — helpful. A couple clarifying questions after reviewing the onboarding form: 

- Our ERP exports line items as free-text "item_description" and separate billing code columns (GL code). If Redwood requires structured SKU/part numbers for matching, we may need to add an extra export column. Is SKU required or will PO number + description suffice?
- For invoices that reference multiple Redwood POs on the same invoice, should we send them as separate PDF pages (one per PO) or include multiple PO lines on the same invoice PDF? Our system usually produces one invoice with several PO references.

Sample invoice attached for reference.

Regards,
Marta

Attachment: sample_invoice_starlight.xlsx (Excel, 42 KB)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 01:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor setup & invoice submission options (Starlight)

Quick AP note / proposed decision: 

- SKU / part number: not required for AP matching. PO number + invoice number + line description + unit price/qty are sufficient for automated ingest. If sellers provide SKU it helps downstream GL mapping but it's optional.
- Multi-PO invoices: we prefer a single PDF with multiple PO lines clearly labeled under each line item (i.e., include a PO column on every line). That lets the ingest map lines to POs rather than splitting files.
- Email fallback: if vendors email invoices, please put "AP_INVOICE:PO-XXXXX" in the subject line so our parser can route correctly. Example subject: "AP_INVOICE: PO-4321 — Starlight Logistics Invoice 20261201".

I've exported the AP field mapping we asked vendors to follow (attached: ap_field_mapping_v2.csv) — it shows the exact column headers our parser expects. Marta: If you can export with those column names, ingestion should be near-zero-touch.

Marissa Cole
Senior AP Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachment: ap_field_mapping_v2.csv (CSV, 6 KB)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@starlight-logistics.com>, accounts-payable@starlight-logistics.com

Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 02:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor setup & invoice submission options (Starlight)

Marta / Tom — thanks for the quick turn. Summary & next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Decision: Use the Redwood vendor portal for all new invoices going forward (preferred). Email is allowed for the first 2 billing cycles while integration is completed, but please follow the subject-line convention Marissa suggested so our ingest picks it up.

Minimum required fields for automated processing: PO number, Invoice number, Invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD), Line-level description, Unit price, Quantity, Currency. SKU optional. For multi-PO invoices include a dedicated PO column on each line.

Action items: 
- Marta: confirm you can export using the ap_field_mapping_v2.csv headers and upload the sample file by EOD Friday. (Attachment or portal upload both fine.)
- Marissa / Neha: once Marta confirms, please enable Starlight's vendor profile and set email fallback routing for two billing cycles.
- Karthik: coordinate a short SLA note for the vendor portal onboarding (estimated 5 business days to fully onboard).

I will follow up with the portal invite link and required DocuSign for terms.

Olga
Vendor Success — Redwood Inference
